'''Cheryl Kallenbach''' playtested the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules" /> The card name [[Chyler]] is an anagram of her name. [[Chall Bekan]] and Imperial Helmsman (Bachenhall) come from the Kallenbach family name.
